column3: dear to the sons of Pandu
with eyes unclouded by the name "protects"
may he protect from the unwholesome
with deep fear, grasping the feet
shade of the umbrella of lotus feet
carrier of the honey of the lotus feet
the blessing, likewise of one who serves the lotus feet
at the foot, nameless and formless
at the feet of the foe of the demons
said at the feet of her husband
at the feet of the husband
at the feet, destroyer of distress
shade at the feet, gone away
unable to part from the feet
the heavenly river from washing of feet
by massaging feet and so on
having smelt the fragrance of lotus feet
obtained by service at the feet
like serpents at touch of feet
removing sin by touch of feet
lotus-footed, teacher of all arts, danced
worship of the lotus feet here
from the blind well of home, the mind on the lotus feet
constantly from the honey-flavour of the lotus feet
of those immersed in the dust of lotus feet
than a dog-cooker averse to lotus feet
the child bowed at the feet
asked of him unperturbed at the feet
servant of the servants of single-foot-root
having prepared water for feet and so on
with water for feet, arghya, sipping and so on
for water for feet, arghya, sipping
by water for feet, worship and so on
services like water for feet, touching water, worship
with drink, fodder, caves, bulbs, roots
of those being cooked in sin
by that being cooked in sin
suicide by those subject to sin
in the form of sin, merit and so on
the more sinful on the wrong path
the greater sinner in hell hereafter
may the Man-Lion, enemy of the chief of demons, protect
the support of sins is the anus
one who knows the other side
took to the paramahamsa order itself
the far shore was reached by you
pigeons, cuckoos, cranes, chakravakas, water-hens, swans, parrots, partridges, peacocks
one with wavering sight, thirst gone
(they) brought dowry for the two in wonderful garments
royal swan with fan and chowries whirling at the side
grieving like for a son at the side
lotus hand of Achyuta at his side
disregarding the cares of protecting, feeding, caressing
revived the cowherds with a glance of grace
by nooses of Varuna and men
(they) will drink the smile-nectar of lifted sidelong glances
was welcomed by parents with blessings
the parents who got their purpose
stood with folded hands before father and son
like a son of the father
should bring satisfaction to ancestors daily
to be inferred from father and son
preside over what is given by fathers
ancestors, beings, lords of creatures and so on
slanderers of father and mother, those full of thirst, devoid of life-stage dharma
lord of the world of ancestors
in the presence of the father
with feelings like their father toward their lord
with feelings like father toward their lord, their mothers
means to kill the killer of father
went from parents to home, with mind deluded by women
of parents in the path of the one of excellent fame
with fat and skin eaten by ants
for him who drinks Achyuta's nectar elsewhere
as if drinking, ran at in anger
with seat, mortar and so on
holes, with seat, mortar and so on
whose city and army were being crushed
even by immortals who have drunk nectar
among the splendour of plump long eight-armed circle
wonderful, risen from the plump serpent coils
whose bodily duties are drained by the nectar
with ears erect, drinking the nectar
with ears erect to drink the nectar
means for pleasing you for man
of men whose desires are unfulfilled
of men who are not deceitful
of men who have gone the path beyond the world
for the man, the removal of the unborn's impulse
like stars with arrow after arrow falling
tail of the serpent, inauspicious limb
at the tail-tip with head down
two bodies smeared with holy perfumes
wind fragrant with touch of Yaksha women's limbs
holy lands, rivers, mountains, forests, hermitages
holy, meaning unconcealed, story very wondrous, devoted to yoga
by the story of holy hearing
of the holy-famed of wild fame
of him of praiseworthy holy deeds
of those of praiseworthy holy deeds
in holy garden and mountain groves
in holy garden and mountain groves, in muddless waters
with sons, wives and so on
by the sin done for sons
mind set on son, wife, wealth
heard of the death of sons
of sons, grandsons and so on
with the form of sons, grandsons
in the form of sons, grandsons and so on
of the two sons being taken away
wishing the death of the son by force
dripping out of affection for son
of the sons of immeasurable splendour
